trans-unit.source: Do you think us defeating Dhaos here will prevent my parents' deaths?
trans-unit.target: Do you think us defeating Dhaos here will prevent my parents' deaths?

trans-unit.source: I...don't think we can reverse what has already happened.
trans-unit.target: I...don't think we can reverse what has already happened.

trans-unit.source: It's not your fault. Think we'll be able to save <Chester> and Mr. Morrison, at least?
trans-unit.target: It's not your fault. Think we'll be able to save <Chester> and Mr. Morrison, at least?

trans-unit.source: I imagine--No, I'm absolutely *sure* we can.
trans-unit.target: I imagine--No, I'm absolutely *sure* we can.

trans-unit.source: I'm glad you feel the same way. I think that's why Mr. Morrison chose to send us here.
trans-unit.target: I'm glad you feel the same way. I think that's why Mr. Morrison chose to send us here.
